title: SM-ACC-004C1: one-time idempotent organization opening balance cutover
authority: Owner 2026-10-29 requested continuation of accounting-first Hybrid V6; specific initial cutover is a narrowly scoped design candidate subject to CI and review.
scope: One initial opening journal and immutable org-scoped batch with date cutoff and exact balance, replay, tenant permissions, SQL protection and tests; preserve normal ledger and optional POS.
out_of_scope: annual rollover, opening balance corrections, automatic offset/equity, complete financial reporting, invoice/AR/AP, external commerce, ZATCA and production deployment
task: Implement ADR 0015: organization-scoped, exactly-once opening journal with posted-journal batch, cutoff and audit. Protect in DB and APIs; test rollback, same-key replay and cross-tenant isolation.
validation: Governance packet validation and exact-head Foundation+Accounting Web+Governance CI with migrations, disposable Postgres, idempotency and browser; no production or live merchant data.
stop_conditions: Change of main, unsafe accounting assumptions, cross-tenant leaks, direct-SQL financial bypass, failed migration/tests, non-atomic journal/metadata creation.
success_criteria: Only one opening per org, balanced leaf journal, correct cutover, idempotent replay, SQL bypass denial, global owner grant enforced, accountant read, full CI and review pass.
